description: This file contains utility functions related to package management automation within the OE (OpenEmbedded) build system. It includes functions for selecting and interacting with different package managers (rpm, ipk, deb), extracting required packages for testing, and installing/uninstalling packages on target devices during test execution.

methods.name: get_package_manager(d, root_path)
methods.description: Returns an OE package manager instance based on the package type specified in the variable dictionary 'd'. Supports rpm, ipk, and deb.

methods.name: find_packages_to_extract(test_suite)
methods.description: Determines which packages need to be extracted for runtime tests based on test suite files.

methods.name: _get_json_file(module_path)
methods.description: Returns the path to the JSON file associated with a module, if both the module and its JSON counterpart exist.

methods.name: _get_needed_packages(json_file, test=None)
methods.description: Parses a JSON file to extract the needed packages, optionally filtering for a specific test.

methods.name: extract_packages(d, needed_packages)
methods.description: Extracts or copies required packages during testing, managing their presence in the test environment.

methods.name: _extract_in_tmpdir(d, pkg)
methods.description: Uses the package manager to extract a package into a temporary directory without dependencies.

methods.name: _copy_package(d, pkg)
methods.description: Copies a package file (RPM, DEB, IPK) to the target directory.

methods.name: install_package(test_case)
methods.description: Installs required packages onto the device under test if needed.

methods.name: uninstall_package(test_case)
methods.description: Uninstalls packages from the device under test if required.

methods.name: test_needs_package(test_case)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific test case requires package installation or uninstallation.

methods.name: _install_uninstall_packages(needed_packages, test_case, install=True)
methods.description: Handles the actual installation or removal of packages during tests.
